title: Wave
description: One hand-authored wave: the file game/waves/<wave id>.json. The wave id is the file name without .json and matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$; the file holds no id of its own. The file playlist.json in the same folder is the playlist, not a wave (playlist.schema.json). A wave is a scroll distance, length_px; each placement comes due when the world has scrolled at_px since the wave's start, so the wave keeps its layout at every level and just arrives faster (09-waves.md, rules 2 and 9). The spawn spot (x, y) is in screen px, y down, the same as the debug test spawn list and every drifter's placement (07-drifters.md, rule 13). Drifter values are never set here: only placement fields (09-waves.md, rule 12). Loaded at startup in both modes by game/app/waves.py and checked by core.wave_files.build_wave_book (docs/contracts/systems/waves.md, Rules, The wave files). Rules this schema can't express, also enforced by the loader: type is a built drifter type (a DrifterType value); every placement is spawned once at load, so a missing coordinate, an unknown variant, or an invert or specialty the drifter refuses is refused naming the placement; a hazard (a drifter whose touch is a hit) may not have at_px below 120, the seam_clear of 09-waves.md (pickups and floating islands may: wave_check, not the loader, counts islands for the seam); seed is refused on a drifter that has none (only the UFO has one, DRA-104), a UFO's y outside its band is refused by its load-time spawn, and two UFOs in one wave may not end up with the same seed, given or default (drifters/07-ufo.md, seed: two UFOs in one wave never share a path). Not checked at load: the seam at the wave's end, gaps, coin distances and the bot path (wave_check, later; 09-waves.md, rule 7). Owner of the schema: architect.

length_px.description: The wave's length, px of scroll, > 0. The wave ends on the tick the world has scrolled this far since its start (09-waves.md, rule 9). Example: 30 s at Level 1 is 1980.

kind.description: "fixed": played where a playlist names it. "pool": picked for random slots (09-waves.md, rule 10).

min_level.description: Pool waves only, and required for them: the lowest level the wave may be picked at, 1 to 8. Refused on a fixed wave.

extra_rest_ticks.description: Ticks added to the rest gap after this wave, >= 0. Left out: 0. Never scales with level (09-waves.md, rule 11; 08-difficulty.md, rule 6).

placements.description: The wave's drifters, in any order; the loader sorts them by at_px, ties kept in file order. May be empty.

at_px.description: Trigger: px of scroll from the wave's start, >= 0. The drifter enters the run on the first tick the wave has scrolled this far. A hazard needs at least 120 (09-waves.md, seam_clear and rule 7.4).

type.description: The drifter type value, e.g. "meteorite", "satellite", "chain_lightning", "fireball", "coin", "floating_island", "planet", "ufo" or "electric_ball" (DRA-111). A planet, a UFO and an electric ball are hazards: each needs at_px of at least 120.

x.description: Center x, screen px. Required for the meteorite, the chain lightning, the coin, the floating island, the planet and the electric ball (its ball's center). Left out for a satellite or a UFO (just outside the wall it enters from). For a fireball: as in the debug test spawn list (x alone an entry along the top; neither x nor y its corner entry).

y.description: Center y, screen px, y down. Required for the satellite and the UFO; a UFO's y must lie inside its band, y 188 to 440 with the committed tuning (drifters/07-ufo.md, start and band). Left out for a meteorite, a chain lightning, a fireball, a coin, a floating island, a planet or an electric ball: just above the top edge (a planet with its field ring touching it; an electric ball with its ball touching it). A coin or a floating island with x and y shows at that spot at once; a planet shows there after its entry warning.

variant.description: A variant name from the drifter's tuning file. Left out: the drifter's default variant.

invert.description: The drifter's invert (07-drifters.md, rule 13). Left out: false. A drifter without one refuses true; a floating island has one for its l_shape, t_shape and triangle only (05-floating-islands.md, rule 9). An electric ball accepts it and it changes nothing (drifters/10-electric-ball.md, rule 8; DRA-111).

specialty.description: The specialty switch (07-drifters.md, rule 11). Left out: the drifter's default. A drifter without a specialty refuses true.

seed.description: UFO only (DRA-104; drifters/07-ufo.md, seed and rule 10): picks the UFO's path. The same seed flies the same path every time. Left out: a default seed fixed by the wave id and this placement's index in the placements list (core.drifters.spawner.placement_seed), so the wave still flies the same path every time, until the file is renamed or its placements are reordered. Two UFOs in one wave may not have the same seed. Refused on every other drifter.

as_level.description: A level, 1 to 8, whose hazard speed and Timer values this drifter uses instead of the run's level (08-difficulty.md, rule 3). Left out: the run's level when it comes due.
